text: oneil: "day_vol 1.2 fails C16; fourth in group". For me 1.2 is modest expansion, a weight (C6), and I carry it. The stronger point is location: a fresh break at a new high close to the pivot (C5), coil strong, ret_12m 108.06 in a passing Template (C3). Group order matters (C11) - that is why I sit at 3, not higher. We agree on the trigger: a 1-hour clear of bar_high on 1.4x volume. A breakout reversed on volume drops my support.
